skill.name: project-interview

skill.summary: Guides conversational learner interviews and records profile data for project setup.

The guidance tells the interviewer to extract information from the learner's prior answers. This is learner profiling context, not system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Learning projects need clear learner context before content generation. This skill guides natural interviews and records confirmed learner profiles.
actual_capabilities: Provides example interview flows for rich and minimal learner input.
Defines learner profile fields such as topic, level, motivation, style, and volume.
Shows how to summarize learner profiles for confirmation.
Includes an interview-data.md template for conversation records.
Guides follow-up questions based on learner responses and emotional cues.
limitations: Does not include executable code or automated validation.
Assumes a separate project-interviewer agent invokes the skill.
Does not include the persona.md template itself.

use_cases.title: Prepare Learning Project Onboarding
use_cases.description: Run a short interview that captures goals, prior knowledge, motivation, preferred style, and desired document length.

use_cases.title: Design Personalized Study Materials
use_cases.description: Use confirmed profile details to shape course scope, tone, examples, and depth before content creation begins.

use_cases.title: Build Interviewing Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Add reference flows and record templates to an AI agent that gathers learner context during project initialization.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the project-interview skill to ask what I want to learn, why it matters, and what level I have now.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm a Learner Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me about my learning project, then summarize my topic, level, motivation, style preference, and document size for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Minimal Input
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-interview when the learner only says they want to study something useful. Ask natural follow-up questions and infer missing profile fields carefully.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Completed Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this completed project interview, identify missing persona details, ask only high-value follow-up questions, and update the confirmed profile summary.

output_examples.input: A learner says they want to study Rust async programming for backend work.
output_examples.output: The skill guides a profile summary covering Rust topic scope, backend background, intermediate level, work motivation, practical style, and medium document size.

output_examples.input: A learner only says they want to learn investing but feels nervous.
output_examples.output: The interview starts with broad questions, notes the learner's uncertainty, and recommends beginner-friendly material focused on principles before action.

output_examples.input: The learner corrects the desired length and asks for more examples.
output_examples.output: The conversation record updates the confirmed volume and style preference, then keeps the correction available for persona generation.

best_practices: Start with broad questions before asking for details.
Use the learner's own words when summarizing the profile.
Confirm the profile before saving interview data.
anti_patterns: Do not force a fixed question order.
Do not ask for details already provided.
Do not pressure learners to share information they avoid.

faq.question: Does this skill run scripts?
faq.answer: No. It provides Markdown guidance and templates for an interviewing workflow.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What output does it help create?
faq.answer: It helps create a learner profile summary, interview-data.md, and metadata for project initialization.

faq.question: Can it handle short learner answers?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show how to ask natural follow-up questions when input is minimal.

faq.question: Does it replace a course design process?
faq.answer: No. It gathers learner context before a separate process creates study materials.

faq.question: Is the skill language-specific?
faq.answer: No, but the included examples are mainly Korean and may need adaptation for other languages.
